strengths: analysis runs locally and every finding carries its evidence and limitations
reuses an existing Ghidra/IDA/Hopper/Rizin/Frida/JADX install instead of shipping its own engine
static JavaScript/Electron analysis needs no native engine at all
limitations: runtime is Node ^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1; the installer will not upgrade Node for you, and older versions are a documented breaking change
native analysis needs Ghidra/IDA/Hopper/Rizin already installed; only the JS/Electron path is self-contained
the README lists binaries, JS/Electron (ASAR), .NET assemblies, websites and firmware containers (UF2/DfuSe/HEX); crash dumps and network captures are not listed -- HAR appears only in commit history
on Linux the static paths need a procps-compatible ps for process ownership checks
driving a commercial engine (IDA, Hopper) still requires that engine's own licence
acceptance: `rea --help` prints a version, and the probe receipt records it with the Node version
one finding on a pinned artifact, with the artifact SHA-256 and the tool transcript
the same finding reproduces from a directory outside the target project
the receipt names the engine behind each claim, so a static-only result is not written up as runtime-proven
providers.source_note: Registered 2026-10-31 from the repository README and LICENSE. The previous entry said runtime python and integration mcp+connector; rea-agents is an npm package that ships an MCP server and a CLI, and no AEP connector exists for it, so both fields were wrong.
providers.license_note: MIT (morluto/rea). The engines it drives (IDA Pro, Hopper, Ghidra) carry their own licences and are not redistributed by rea.

strengths: headless mode through idalib means no IDA GUI has to stay open
each database runs in its own worker process, so a supervisor can reattach instead of restarting analysis
read-only resources plus decompile/disasm/xrefs cover most of what an analysis needs before any write
limitations: requires IDA Pro 8.3 or newer (9 recommended) and a commercial licence; IDA Free is not supported at all
the upstream README now recommends Hex-Rays' official ida-mcp and marks the GUI plugin path deprecated, so this entry may be superseded rather than promoted

exposes py_eval, which runs arbitrary Python inside IDA, and patch/patch_asm/rename/set_comments, which mutate the database -- an unqualified connection is a write-capable shell into a licensed product
GUI mode needs a running IDA instance; headless mode needs idalib activated globally plus uv
every tool call must name its database explicitly, so a caller that assumes a current database will fail
acceptance: `idalib-mcp --stdio` answers ida://idb/metadata for a pinned sample, and the receipt records the IDA version
the exposed tool list is restricted to the read-only subset: no py_eval, no patch*, no rename, and the allowlist is recorded in the receipt
analysis runs against a copy of the IDB and the original file hash is unchanged afterwards
one decompiled function is quoted with its address, so a reader can re-check the claim instead of trusting the summary
providers.source_note: Registered 2026-10-31 from the repository README and LICENSE. Deliberately left at candidate: nothing here has been run, and the py_eval/patch surface means the first probe has to prove the allowlist before anything else.
providers.license_note: MIT (Duncan Ogilvie / mrexodia). IDA Pro and idalib are commercial Hex-Rays products and are not redistributable; this entry references them, it does not ship them.

strengths: runs on one 24 GB card in bfloat16 through plain transformers, with no SGLang or custom serving stack
answers absolute pixel coordinates, which is the format it was trained on
limitations: measured on 3 real windows x 2 prompt formats x 2 phrasings: 4 of 12 answers were admissible and only 1 of those 4 was correct, so admissibility is not correctness
with the 0-999 grid prompt this repository uses for Mage, all 6 answers fell outside the grid (width or height 1000-1021) and were refused rather than clamped
with pixel coordinates and the single word 'composer', all 3 answers were admissible and all 3 were wrong: the boxes landed on the sidebar, the top of the transcript and a right-panel table cell
only pixel coordinates plus a plain-language description produced a correct box (Qoder), and the other two windows were then refused for overflowing the window
the weights ship under the Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE AGREEMENT, not Apache-2.0, so this cannot be the production grounding service regardless of accuracy
acceptance: one composer located on a real window and confirmed by OCR text inside the returned box, not by the model's own confidence
the reference is independent of the model: an OCR line box or a human-calibrated ratio from the client profile
the disagreement rate is reported per prompt format, because the format changed the answer more than the model did
providers.source_note: Registered 2026-10-31 after actually running it: 12 measured cells recorded in docs/VISION_GROUNDING_PROBE_20261031.zh-CN.md. Left at candidate because the only correct answer came from one prompt format on one window.
providers.license_note: Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE AGREEMENT (verified from the model card on 2026-10-31), not Apache-2.0. Weights are downloaded at run time and are not redistributed here.

strengths: single 4B policy that switches between GUI actions and terminal/code actions per step
strong GUI grounding for its size (ScreenSpot-v2 87.2, OSWorld-G 56.9)
asymmetric working memory: last 3 screenshots, 4 full replies, folded Action history
limitations: 66.04 OSWorld-Verified includes an unrestricted bash channel; the GUI-only stage scores 45.56
perception cannot defeat UIPI: an elevated target still refuses input from a lower integrity level
Linux 1920x1080 pyautogui training domain; Windows chrome, DPI scaling and fonts are out of distribution
custom llava_onevision2 architecture: trust_remote_code=True executes repository code at load time
trained and evaluated in disposable containers; no notion of leases, claims, ACKs or live user sessions
acceptance: served model answers /health on pinned SGLang 0.5.2 + torch 2.8.0+cu128 + flashinfer 0.3.1, revision hash recorded
grounding agreement measured against coord-uia observe on the same Windows window, disagreement rate published
no bash channel and no host path exposed: actions arrive as a proposed region and are executed by the CUA driver
one event delivered end to end with input_verified, composer_cleared and a same-event Agent ACK
providers.source_note: Registered from the public Microsoft Mage release (weights and OSWorld harness published 2026-10-30). Not installed, not downloaded, not trusted: this row exists so that a probe has somewhere to land and so that its acceptance criteria are written down before any numbers are seen.
